title: 第十五章 天道神功第三更第十六章 洗筋伐髓第四更
content_zh:
神、圣级别的修炼功法，别说洪天学院，就算一些绝世大宗门，都未必能有，而且就算有，也隐藏的很深，普通人是永远没办法接触的。
他要是能创出这种功法，以后修炼必然事半功倍，越来越快！
“刚好也没有第四重的修炼方法，去教师藏书阁看看！”
学院修炼洪天九重诀，每修炼一层才有资格领取下一层的秘籍，他这里只有第三重的修炼方法，第四重还从未见过。
走出住处，此刻天刚黑不久，路上还有不少行人。
明亮的月光下，地面朦胧，宛如洒了一层白银，不少偷尝禁果的情侣，依偎在树下，悄悄说着情话，一片恬静。
张悬没工夫看这些，脚下加快，时间不长，一个巨大的高楼出现在眼前。
藏书阁分为教师、学生两大部分，收藏了学院各种秘籍、功法，是整个学院最重要的地方之一。
“墨老！”
走到门前，对着坐在大门不远的一个老者躬身。
墨老，藏书阁守护者之一，实力不知道达到什么境界了，据说在学院都能排的上号，只是已经多年没出过手，没人知道确切实力。
“你来了！突破到武者四重了？”
墨老看过来，捋着稀疏的胡须。
“侥幸而已！”张悬也不隐瞒。
“不错，不错，好好修炼，学院还是需要你们这些年轻血液的注入！”墨老满意的点头：“第四重的秘籍就在功法的第四排书架，自己去吧！”
“是！”张悬也不多说，抬脚走进房间。
他一离开，墨老忍不住摇了摇头，不由感慨：“孩子是好孩子，就是天赋差了点，修炼也有些太慢了！”
别人一个武者三重，两年时间就能突破，这个张悬足足三年多了，才成功破境，天赋的确不怎么样。
“达到武者四重，好好修炼的话，当个普通老师还是可以的，就希望下次师资考核不要太差了……”
嘀咕一声，墨老不再多说，将眼睛再次闭上。

张悬只是诸多年轻老师中，比较有礼貌的一个，算不上喜欢，也算不上不喜欢，只是觉得天赋不好有些惋惜罢了。
不知道墨老的嘀咕，张悬走进藏书阁。
洪天学院的藏书阁虽然也有一定规模，比起他前世工作的地方丝毫不差，但和脑海中的天道图书馆比，就差的太多了。
两者根本不在一个档次。
快步走到功法区，找到第四排。
这里果然有洪天九重诀第四重的修炼方法。
伸手抽了出来，随手翻阅。
呼！
脑海中出现了一本相同的秘技，打开一看，和第三重差不多，足有上千处缺点。
“这里刚好还有其他秘技，一块看看！”
有了之前突破的经验，张悬也不看缺点是什么，而是看向眼前的书架。
第四排书架，上面密密麻麻摆满了各种各样的功法，都是第四重的修炼方法，还有不少前人留下的笔记、注解，密密麻麻足有数千本之多。
换做别人，只看一眼肯定就花眼了，毕竟这么多书，不少注解、功法理论甚至都截然相反，不知道正确与否，贸然修炼，弄不好就会走火入魔。
张悬不一样，拥有天道图书馆，就等于能够自动辨别正确与否，当即也不犹豫，随手拿起一本，轻轻翻阅。
呼！
脑海中出现一本相同的书籍。
张悬没有停顿继续拿起下一本。
他现在不是观看，也不是挑选，而是让天道图书馆拥有更多的书籍，这样才能更好的选出正确的修炼方法。
哗啦啦！
房间内响起了不停翻阅书籍的声音。

“心性不坚，浮躁浮夸！”
听到声音，墨老眉头一皱。
既然已经修炼洪天九重诀了，就不要再想其他的，抓紧时间将第四重法诀抄完，回去研究修炼即可，虽说他山之石，可以攻玉，但修为见识没到，看的越多越杂，心神越容易浮躁，到最后，一事无成倒是小事，弄不好还会走火入魔，彻底报废！
三十年前，就曾出现过这样一个例子，一位天才老师，惊才绝艳，自认为超出别人太多，非要博览众家，创出适合自己的绝招，结果看过的功法太多，不确定选择哪一个，导致走火入魔，整个人也疯了。
content_en:
Not to mention Hongtian Academy, even some peerless sects may not have the cultivation techniques at the divine and saint level, and even if they do exist, they are deeply hidden and ordinary people will never be able to access them.
If he can create this kind of technique, his future cultivation will definitely get twice the result with half the effort, faster and faster!
"There happens to be no fourth-level cultivation method, so go to the teacher's library and have a look!"
The academy practices the Nine Levels of Hongtian Art, and each level of cultivation is eligible to receive the secret book for the next level. He only has the third level of cultivation methods here, and has never seen the fourth level before.
When we walked out of our residence, it was just getting dark and there were many pedestrians on the road.
Under the bright moonlight, the ground was hazy, as if sprinkled with a layer of silver. Many couples who had tasted the forbidden fruit cuddled under the trees, whispering love words in a peaceful atmosphere.
Zhang Xuan didn't have time to look at this, he stepped faster, and not long after, a huge tall building appeared in front of him.
The library is divided into two parts: teachers and students. It collects various secret books and exercises in the academy. It is one of the most important places in the entire academy.
"Old Mo!"
He walked to the door and bowed to an old man sitting not far from the door.
Mr. Mo, one of the guardians of the library, has reached an unknown level of strength. It is said that he can be ranked high in the academy, but he has not made a move for many years, and no one knows the exact strength.
"You're here! Have you broken through to the fourth level of a warrior?"
Mr. Mo looked over and stroked his sparse beard.
"It's just a fluke!" Zhang Xuan didn't hide it either.
"Yes, yes, practice hard. The academy still needs the injection of young blood like you!" Mr. Mo nodded with satisfaction: "The secret book of the fourth level is on the fourth row of the bookshelf of the exercise. Go yourself!"
"Yes!" Zhang Xuan walked into the room without saying much.
As soon as he left, Mr. Mo couldn't help but shook his head, and couldn't help but sigh: "The child is a good child, but his talent is a bit lacking, and his cultivation is a bit too slow!"
Others, a third-level warrior, could break through in two years. It took Zhang Xuan more than three years to successfully break through. His talent was indeed not that good.
"If you reach the fourth level of a warrior and practice hard, you can still be an ordinary teacher. I hope the next teacher assessment won't be too bad..."
After muttering, Mr. Mo stopped talking and closed his eyes again.
Zhang Xuan is just one of the more polite young teachers. He doesn't really like him, nor does he dislike him. He just feels a little regretful that his talent is not good.
Unaware of Mr. Mo's muttering, Zhang Xuan walked into the library.
Although the library of Hongtian College is of a certain scale and is no worse than the place where he worked in his previous life, it is far behind compared to the Tiandao Library in his mind.
The two are not on the same level at all.
Quickly walk to the exercise area and find the fourth row.
As expected, there is a cultivation method for the fourth level of Hongtian's Nine Levels Technique here.
He reached out and took it out, flipping through it.
call!
The same secret book appeared in my mind. When I opened it, I saw that it was almost the same as the third level, with thousands of shortcomings.
"There happens to be other secret skills here, let's take a look!"
With the experience of previous breakthroughs, Zhang Xuan did not look at the shortcomings, but looked at the bookshelf in front of him.
The fourth row of bookshelves is densely filled with various exercises, all of which are the fourth level of cultivation methods. There are also many notes and annotations left by predecessors, and there are thousands of them.
For others, it would definitely be dazzling just by looking at it. After all, there are so many books, many annotations, and theory of exercises that are completely opposite. If you don't know whether they are correct or not, if you practice rashly, you will go crazy.
Zhang Xuan is different. Having the Tiandao Library means that he can automatically identify whether it is correct or not. He immediately picks up a book and reads it lightly without hesitation.
call!
An identical book appeared in my mind.
Zhang Xuan continued to pick up the next book without pausing.
He is not watching or selecting now, but letting Tiandao Library have more books, so that he canCan better choose the correct cultivation method.
Wow!
The sound of books being flipped through was heard in the room.
"Weak character, impetuous and exaggerated!"
Hearing the sound, Mr. Mo frowned.
Now that you have practiced Hongtian's ninth-level art, don't think about anything else. Take the time to copy the fourth-level art and go back to study and practice. Although stones from other mountains can attack jade, you don't have enough knowledge of cultivation. The more you read, the more complicated it becomes, and the easier it is to become impetuous. In the end, it's a trivial matter to achieve nothing. If you don't do it well, you will go crazy and be completely scrapped!
Thirty years ago, there was an example of a genius teacher who was extremely talented. He thought he was too far ahead of others, so he insisted on reading a lot of techniques to create a unique technique that suited him. As a result, he had seen too many techniques and was not sure which one to choose. As a result, he became obsessed and went crazy.
